T: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Sushi too.
D: A former assassin wakes from a coma and goes after the people who tried to kill her.
P: Serve the sushi when the Bride walks into Hattori Hanzo's sushi bar.
S: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri with sliced salmon and tuna, a dab of wasabi, served on a board with pickled ginger.
House of Blue Leaves crispy pork gyoza
the Tokyo restaurant before the fight

Pork, cabbage, garlic and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath and steamed tender, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Mix 400g pork mince with 150g finely shredded cabbage squeezed dry, 2 crushed garlic cloves, grated ginger, 2 chopped spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 32 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry in batches in an oiled pan for 2 minutes until brown underneath, add 80ml water, cover and steam 3 minutes until dry. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tsp chilli oil to dip.
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with miso butter, sprinkled with shichimi and spring onion.
M: the Tokyo restaurant where O-Ren holds court

Chicken thigh skewers and chicken and spring onion skewers grilled over high heat, brushed with a tare of soy, mirin, sake and sugar reduced. Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

Rich miso and sesame broth with spicy pork mince, springy ramen noodles, a jammy soy egg, corn, bean sprouts, nori and chilli oil. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, chill and peel, then soak in 3 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin for 2 hours. Fry 300g pork mince with garlic, ginger and 1 tbsp chilli bean paste until crisp. Heat 1.6L chicken stock and whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 2 tbsp tahini. Cook 4 portions fresh ramen noodles for 2 minutes and divide into bowls. Ladle over broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, sprouts, nori and chilli oil.
W: Matcha sifted and whisked into warm milk and cream, poured onto yolks beaten with sugar, cooked to 82C, strained, chilled overnight and churned.
K: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink

Junmai sake shaken hard with yuzu juice, honey syrup and egg white until frothy, strained into a chilled glass with a twist of lemon. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp warm water for honey syrup. For each drink, shake 60ml junmai sake, 20ml yuzu juice, 15ml honey syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain into a chilled coupe and finish with a twist of lemon peel.

s.note: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into small fingers. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna and a dab of wasabi. Serve on a board with pickled ginger.
Grill 4 corn cobs until charred all over. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp white miso and brush over. Sprinkle with shichimi togarashi and sliced spring onion.

m.note: the Tokyo restaurant where O-Ren holds court
m.how: Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into 300ml warm milk and 300ml cream. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Strain, chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.
